# Component Catalogue

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen/components.js from packages/ui/src. Do not edit; run `npm run gen:components`. -->

Every shared component of both apps, read from its header and its props in `packages/ui/src`.
Features import from `@mycity/ui` only, and never build their own copy of anything listed here.

**Need something that is not here?** Add it to the package, never inside a feature:

```bash
npm run new:component -- --name StatusPill --group Display
```

That writes the component with its header, a test and a gallery page, exports it from its group,
and regenerates this file. Fill the header, build it, run `npm -w @mycity/ui test` and see it in
`npm run gallery`. `scripts/check/components.js` fails a stale catalogue, a component without a full
header, test or gallery page, and a feature that re-creates or shadows a component listed here.

## Foundations

### Icon

One Lucide glyph by its short name, drawn in the current text colour.

| | |
|---|---|
| Use | Beside a word on a button, a nav item, a KPI card or a status line; alone only for well known actions inside an IconButton. |
| Avoid | Emoji, another icon set or an inline SVG; an icon alone with no IconButton or label around it. |
| Phone | The same glyph; the bottom bar and the More tiles show it at 20 or 24 px. |
| Accessibility | Decorative (aria-hidden) unless given a label, which makes it role="img" with that name. |
| Status | stable |
| Exports | `Icon` |
| Import | `import { Icon } from "@mycity/ui";` |
| File | `packages/ui/src/icons/Icon.tsx` |
| Test | `packages/ui/src/icons/Icon.test.tsx` |
| Gallery | `packages/ui/src/icons/Icon.gallery.tsx` (`npm run gallery`, `#/Icon`) |

**Icon** props (`IconProps`)

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `IconName` | yes | The glyph, by its short name. |
| `size` | `"s" \| "m" \| "l"` |  | `s` 16 px inline (the default), `m` 20 px navigation, `l` 24 px bottom bar and tiles. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes: a token text colour, or a size class to override the box. |
| `label` | `string` |  | Gives the icon a name for assistive technology; without it the icon is decorative. |

```tsx
<Icon name="clock" />
<Icon name="alert" size="m" label="Late" />
```

## Actions

### Button

The pill button: default, primary (the yellow one), ghost and danger, with an optional icon either side.

| | |
|---|---|
| Use | Every action a person takes: Create Rule, Clock In, Export. A link that looks like a button passes asChild with an <a>. |
| Avoid | A second primary on one surface (one yellow button per surface); a bare icon (use IconButton); the sign in or clock in call to action (use BigButton). |
| Phone | At least 44 px tall; a footer stretches the primary to full width at the bottom. |
| Accessibility | A native button (type="button" unless set). While loading it stays focusable, says aria-busy and ignores presses. Verb Noun labels, Title Case. |
| Status | stable |
| Exports | `Button`, `IconButton`, `BigButton` |
| Import | `import { Button, IconButton, BigButton } from "@mycity/ui";` |
| File | `packages/ui/src/actions/Button.tsx` |
| Test | `packages/ui/src/actions/Button.test.tsx` |
| Gallery | `packages/ui/src/actions/Button.gallery.tsx` (`npm run gallery`, `#/Button`) |

**Button** props (`ButtonProps`, extends `ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>`)

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `variant` | `"default" \| "primary" \| "ghost" \| "danger"` |  | `primary` is the yellow one, one per surface; `danger` is for destructive actions, confirmed in a dialog. |
| `icon` | `IconName` |  | A glyph before the label. |
| `iconRight` | `IconName` |  | A glyph after the label (a chevron for "View All"). |
| `size` | `"md" \| "sm"` |  | `md` follows the density (36 or 40 px); `sm` is 28 px on desktop. Both are 44 px on a phone. |
| `block` | `boolean` |  | Fills the width: the call to action at the foot of a form or page. |
| `loading` | `boolean` |  | Shows a spinner in place of the icon and ignores presses until the work finishes. |
| `asChild` | `boolean` |  | Renders the single child element (an <a>, a router Link) with the button's look instead of a <button>. |
| `children` | `ReactNode` |  | The label: Verb Noun, Title Case, at most 3 words. |

**IconButton** props (`IconButtonProps`, extends `Omit<ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>, "children" | "aria-label">`)

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `icon` | `IconName` | yes | The glyph. |
| `label` | `string` | yes | What the button does, in words: its accessible name and its tooltip. Required. |
| `size` | `"md" \| "sm"` |  | `md` follows the density; `sm` is 32 px on desktop. Both are 44 px on a phone. |
| `dot` | `boolean` |  | A small red dot for something new (the bell). |

**BigButton** props (`BigButtonProps`, extends `ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>`)

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `icon` | `IconName` |  | A glyph after the label. |
| `loading` | `boolean` |  | Shows a spinner and ignores presses until the work finishes. |

```tsx
<Button variant="primary" icon="plus">New Rule</Button>
<Button variant="ghost" iconRight="right">View All</Button>
```

## Helpers

Not components, but imported from `@mycity/ui` the same way (`packages/ui/src/lib`).

| Export | File | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `cn` | `lib/cn.ts` | Join class names, skipping the falsy ones; of two that conflict, the later wins (`cn("h-control", "h-9")` is `h-9`). |
| `formatDate` | `lib/format.ts` | "2026-10-13" or a full ISO timestamp → "13/10/2026". |
| `formatTime` | `lib/format.ts` | ISO timestamp → "09:14" in Lagos time. |
| `formatDateTime` | `lib/format.ts` | ISO timestamp → "13/10/2026 09:14". |
| `formatWhen` | `lib/format.ts` | ISO timestamp → "09:14" today, "Yesterday", or a day-first date. |
| `formatMonth` | `lib/format.ts` | "2026-10" or "2026-10-01" → "October 2026". |
| `monthName` | `lib/format.ts` | Month name from a zero-based index: 0 → "January". |
| `todayIso` | `lib/format.ts` | Today in Lagos as ISO "YYYY-MM-DD". |
| `parseDayFirst` | `lib/format.ts` | Day-first text a person typed ("13/10/2026", "13-10-2026", "13.10.26") → ISO, or null. |
| `formatMoney` | `lib/format.ts` | Full amount with kobo, for tables and documents. |
| `formatMoneyShort` | `lib/format.ts` | Short form for KPI tiles only: "₦1.3M", "₦850K". |
| `isNegative` | `lib/format.ts` | Is this amount below zero? (string check; no float) |
| `formatCount` | `lib/format.ts` | Whole-number count with thousands separators. |
| `initials` | `lib/format.ts` | Initials for an avatar: "Cynthia Osakunih" → "CO". |
| `formatBytes` | `lib/format.ts` | "84 KB", "1.1 MB" from a byte count. |
| `plural` | `lib/format.ts` | Plural with count: plural(3, "employee") → "3 employees". |
| `ControlIds` (type) | `lib/ids.ts` | The ids of one control and the parts that describe it. |
| `useControlIds` | `lib/ids.ts` | The ids for one control, from a readable stem (the field name) and a page-unique suffix. |
| `describedBy` | `lib/ids.ts` | A space-separated id list for aria-describedby, skipping the parts not shown; undefined when none are. |
| `PHONE_QUERY` | `lib/media.ts` | A phone: 760 px wide and below (gate 11). |
| `useMediaQuery` | `lib/media.ts` | true while the media query matches; false before the first render on a server. |
| `useIsPhone` | `lib/media.ts` | true on a phone: the phone shell renders (gate 11). |
| `useIsMobile` | `lib/media.ts` | The merged screens' name for useIsPhone. |
| `Theme` (type) | `lib/preferences.ts` | The theme in force: light or dark. |
| `ThemeChoice` (type) | `lib/preferences.ts` | What a person may choose: light, dark, or the device's setting. |
| `Density` (type) | `lib/preferences.ts` | Compact (the default) or Comfortable. |
| `configurePreferences` | `lib/preferences.ts` | Sets the storage keys. |
| `themeChoice` | `lib/preferences.ts` | What the person chose: light, dark, or the device's setting. |
| `currentTheme` | `lib/preferences.ts` | The theme in force now: the choice, or the device's setting. |
| `setTheme` | `lib/preferences.ts` | Applies and remembers a theme choice; "system" clears the stored one. |
| `useTheme` | `lib/preferences.ts` | The theme in force, the person's choice, a light and dark toggle, and the setter. |
| `currentDensity` | `lib/preferences.ts` | The density in force: compact unless comfortable is set. |
| `setDensity` | `lib/preferences.ts` | Applies and remembers a density. |
| `useDensity` | `lib/preferences.ts` | Compact (the default on desktop) or Comfortable, remembered per person (F5). |
| `SLOTS` | `lib/slots.ts` | The slot names the screen gates read (five-second.js, two-shells.js): each shared component marks its text with `data-ui="<slot>"`, so a gate knows a page title from a button from a help text without guessing from markup. |
| `Slot` (type) | `lib/slots.ts` | One slot name. |
| `slot` | `lib/slots.ts` | Spread onto an element: `<h1 {...slot("page-title")}>`. |
| `content` | `lib/slots.ts` | Spread onto an element that shows content a person wrote or received. |
